mapper.sql: (a.opening_balance + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE t.trans_type WHEN 'I' THEN t.trans_amount ELSE -t.trans_amount END) FROM personal_transactions t WHERE t.account_num = a.account_num AND t.use_yn = 'Y'), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.transfer_amount) FROM transfers r WHERE r.to_account_num = a.account_num AND r.use_yn = 'Y'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.transfer_amount) FROM transfers r WHERE r.from_account_num = a.account_num AND r.use_yn = 'Y'), 0))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE user_num = #{userNum} AND is_default_yn = 'Y' AND use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT a.account_num, a.account_name, a.account_type, a.opening_balance, a.credit_limit, (a.is_default_yn = 'Y') AS is_default, AS balance FROM accounts a WHERE a.user_num = #{userNum} AND a.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY a.is_default_yn DESC, a.account_num ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET account_name = #{accountName}, account_type = #{accountType}, opening_balance = #{openingBalance}, credit_limit = #{creditLimit} WHERE account_num = #{accountNum} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE accounts SET use_yn = 'N' WHERE account_num = #{accountNum} AND use_yn = 'Y'
